frame.converter: Each sky position onto the midplane of the inclined disc the image layers are baked on (recipe.json), through the image-layer bake's own intersection.

discThickness.basis: The stellar disc's exponential scale height as its scale length over 7.3, the mean flattening Kregel et al. (2002) measured for edge-on discs, with S4G's disc scale length (Salo et al. 2015): 347 pc. The same thickness as the image layers' slabs; for young objects it is an upper value. Each row's own height is drawn, not measured.

meaning: Sources with confirmed Wolf-Rayet signatures in M83 from Hadfield et al. (2005): one dot per source, massive young stars or the clusters that hold them, at its catalogue position.

appearance.note: Presentation only: the blue-white of the young clusters in M31's and M33's dots. Each dot takes its tone and half its colour from the photograph under it (packages/bake/cli/prepare-catalogue-points.mts).
